deed: צוות ישראלי חילץ ילדה בת 9 מהריסות רעידת האדמה בטורקיה 1999
title: Home Front Command rescuers pulled 12 survivors from the ruins in Turkey in 1999, among them 9-year-old Shiran

trailer.text: The Israeli rescue unit is part of the Home Front Command, which was set up after the Gulf War, and according to JTA most of its members are reservists in the army.
On August 17, 1999, hours after an earthquake near Istanbul, Israel mobilized the unit to find survivors.
According to JTA, the Israeli rescuers reached Shiran Franco, a 9-year-old Israeli girl who was trapped in the rubble, and pulled her out alive.
According to JTA, the unit rescued 12 people in Turkey in total.
Turkish Prime Minister Bülent Ecevit said: "I want to express my gratitude to all of the Jewish people for their support."

glance.label: Who
glance.value: The Home Front Command rescue unit

paragraphs.text: According to Ynetnews, Shiran Franco was 9 years old on August 17, 1999.
She was staying with her family in a small apartment hotel when the quake hit.
According to ynet, the family was in Turkey on an August vacation.
According to JTA, the quake lasted 45 seconds, near Istanbul.
According to J., its magnitude was 7.4.
According to ynet, 100 thousand buildings collapsed.
David Peretz, a rescuer in the unit, described to Israel Hayom a five-kilometer road without a single intact building.
According to J., the president of the American Sephardi Federation said that none of Turkey's 23,000 Jews appeared to have been killed or injured in the quake.
According to J., Chief of General Staff Shaul Mofaz instructed the Home Front Command to prepare the rescue teams as soon as news of the disaster arrived.
According to J., on Tuesday night Israel sent 200 soldiers and medical personnel to search for survivors and help the wounded.
The Christian Science Monitor quoted sociologist Moshe Lissak, who said that "In seven hours, they were already in Turkey," without specifying which delegation he meant.
According to J., three Hercules aircraft and a cargo plane flew the team, communications equipment, dogs and about 30 doctors and medics.
According to J., the equipment included heavy tools, air bags, pneumatic jacks and cutters.
According to the Christian Science Monitor, the unit was led by Col. Udi Ben-Uri, and many of its members are civil engineers who know how to assess how a building collapsed.
According to J., the Israeli team was the largest foreign rescue force to arrive on the scene on Tuesday.
According to J., by Wednesday evening at least 19 countries had sent more than 2,300 rescuers to Turkey.
According to J., Israeli President Ezer Weizman telephoned Turkish President Suleyman Demirel to offer support.

stations.title: The engineer in the ruined city

paragraphs.text: According to JTA, Ofer Pomeranz joined the unit in 1989.
He had already been at earlier disasters, among them the Scud missiles in the 1991 Gulf War and the Jewish center in Buenos Aires in 1994.
According to JTA, by 22:00 on Tuesday Pomeranz was already walking through the city of Cinarcik, which had been destroyed in the earthquake.
According to JTA, he was the unit's chief engineer, and his job was to figure out what the buildings looked like before they collapsed.
Prof. Itzik Ashkenazi, a physician who was among the rescuers, told ynet that there were about 100 rescuers, and that they were divided into teams of pairs.
According to JTA, the rescuers were afraid to start drilling at Shiran's site, so as not to hurt her.
According to JTA, Pomeranz, despite his high rank, grabbed a jackhammer and began drilling himself.
According to Maariv, the Home Front Command's Company B, commanded by Eran Magen, also took part in the rescue.
Ashkenazi told ynet that he pointed a flashlight at a pair of red eyes in the dark, and Shiran recoiled and crawled backward in fear.
He said that he told her he was from Israel and had come to take her home.
He said that he was afraid to pull her out, and so he acted slowly.
According to JTA, the doctors said that when they reached her, early Saturday morning, she was dehydrated but in good condition.
According to JTA, many soldiers broke down in tears when Shiran was pulled out of the rubble, and Pomeranz reacted with cool professionalism.
According to ynet, her twin brother Arye, her father Yitzhak and her grandparents Sami and Miriam were killed, and only Shiran and her mother Iris survived.
According to Dei'ah veDibur, Iris was rescued after 36 hours.
According to Dei'ah veDibur, Shiran did not attend the funerals on Monday, because she had not yet been told of her family members' deaths.
According to JTA, the Israeli unit rescued 12 people in total, and pulled bodies from beneath collapsed buildings.
According to the Christian Science Monitor, many Turkish and foreign rescue teams turned to the Israelis for direction.
According to Dei'ah veDibur, on Monday, six days after the quake, the Israelis in Cinarcik rescued Ismail Cimen, a three-year-old Turkish boy.
According to Dei'ah veDibur, he spent more than six days alone under a collapsed balcony, and his father and three sisters were killed.
David Peretz told Israel Hayom that the unit rescued a man who had been trapped for three days in a four-story building, without food and without water.
According to the Irish Times, Israeli soldiers dug for 17 hours in Cinarcik to reach an 11-year-old Turkish girl who had been buried alive.
According to the Irish Times, a doctor on the Israeli team said it was surprising that she survived.
According to JTA, 11-year-old Alif Gondoz was trapped for four days beneath the rubble in Cinarcik.
According to JTA, she lost all of her immediate family, and the American Jewish Joint Distribution Committee brought her to Israel with two aunts to continue her rehabilitation.
According to Maariv, a field hospital set up in the area treated 1,200 injured.

stations.title: "My gratitude to all of the Jewish people"

paragraphs.text: Pomeranz told JTA that the local Turkish population was overwhelmed with gratitude for the work of the Israeli soldiers.
According to JTA, dozens of Turkish citizens applauded each successful rescue, and cheered the soldiers as they headed home.
Turkish Prime Minister Bülent Ecevit said: "I want to express my gratitude to all of the Jewish people for their support."
According to Dei'ah veDibur, the rescue teams and army doctors held a memorial service in Cinarcik for the 11 Israelis and tens of thousands of Turks who were killed.
According to Dei'ah veDibur, Israel offered to rehabilitate part of the damaged area.
According to the Christian Science Monitor, the IDF's aid efforts are a sort of quiet diplomacy for Israel around the globe.
According to the newspaper, in August 1998, in the attack on the US Embassy in Nairobi, Israel took control of the search-and-rescue operation.
According to Maariv, the 1999 earthquake in Turkey was etched into Israeli memory because of the moving images of the rescue of the girl Shiran Franco.
According to Israel Hayom, David Peretz received a commendation for his work in Turkey.
According to ynet in 2019, twenty years after the quake, Shiran had grown up and rebuilt her life.
She enlisted in the army, married and had children.
Ashkenazi told ynet that at age 50 he was discharged from the army and received an offer from Harvard University to head a disasters and terrorism team at the School of Public Health.
He said that he saw Shiran as a significant trigger for this.
According to the Christian Science Monitor, Haaretz military correspondent Zeev Schiff said the unit is good but costs a fortune.
Schiff said the cost of the August rescue effort in Turkey was extremely high.
David Peretz told Israel Hayom that after returning from Turkey, he and some of the group suffered from trauma.
He said that he got back on track only after half a year.

disagreements.question: How many days was Shiran trapped beneath the rubble?

versions.says: JTA, in a report from August 1999: four days
JTA, in an article on Ofer Pomeranz: five days

disagreements.question: How many bodies did the Israeli unit pull from the rubble?

versions.says: Dei'ah veDibur, on August 25, 1999: 146 bodies, at three sites

disagreements.question: How many people were killed in the quake?

versions.says: J., on August 20, 1999: at least 3,500 killed and 16,000 injured
Dei'ah veDibur: Turkish authorities then estimated some 40,000 killed, and said the number might rise
ynet: more than 17 thousand dead and about 44 thousand injured

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur, צוות החילוץ הישראלי הוא חלק מפיקוד העורף, שהוקם אחרי מלחמת המפרץ.
claims.quote: The rescue team sent by Israel is part of the Home Front Command (Pikud Ha'Oref) that was set up after the Gulf War.

claims.quote: Like most of the 330 members of Israel’s world-renowned rescue team, Pomeranz is a reserve in the army.

claims.text: לפי JTA, ב-17 באוגוסט, שעות אחרי רעידת האדמה שנמשכה 45 שניות ליד איסטנבול, ישראל גייסה את יחידת החילוץ המיוחדת שלה כדי לאתר ניצולים.
claims.quote: It was Aug. 17, just hours after the ground shook for 45 devastating seconds near Istanbul, and Israel was mobilizing its special rescue unit to help find survivors.

claims.text: לפי ynetnews מ-2023, שירן הייתה בת 9 ב-17 באוגוסט 1999 ושהתה עם משפחתה במלון דירות קטן כשהרעידה פגעה.
claims.quote: Shiran, who was nine years old on August 17 of 1999, was staying with her family in a small apartment hotel when the quake hit,

claims.text: לפי JTA, צוותי חילוץ ישראליים הצילו ילדה ישראלית בת 9 שהייתה לכודה ארבעה ימים בהריסות רעידת האדמה בטורקיה.
claims.quote: Israeli rescue teams saved a 9-year-old Israeli girl who had been trapped for four days in earthquake rubble in Turkey.

claims.text: לפי JTA, אופר פומרנץ היה מעורב אישית בחילוץ שני אנשים, ובהם שירן פרנקו, ילדה ישראלית בת 9 שחולצה בחיים מההריסות לאחר חמישה ימים.
claims.quote: He was personally involved in the rescue of two people, including Shiran Franco, the 9-year-old Israeli girl who was dramatically pulled out of the rubble alive after five days.

claims.text: לפי JTA, יחידת החילוץ הישראלית חילצה בסך הכול 12 אנשים והוציאה 156 גופות מתחת לבניינים שהתמוטטו.
claims.quote: In total, the unit rescued 12 people and pulled 156 bodies from beneath destroyed buildings.

claims.text: ראש ממשלת טורקיה בולנט אג'ביט אמר: "אני רוצה להביע את תודתי לכל העם היהודי על תמיכתם".
claims.quote: I want to express my gratitude to all of the Jewish people for their support.

claims.quote: במבצע בשנת 99’, שכונה מבצע “חבל הצלה”, חילץ פיקוד העורף 12 ניצולים חיים ולכודים

claims.quote: The devastating 7.4-magnitude quake killed at least 3,500 people, injured 16,000 and left countless others missing.

claims.quote: יותר מ־17 אלף הרוגים וכ־44 אלף פצועים. 100 אלף בניינים קרסו.

claims.text: לפי ה-Irish Times, רופא בצוות הישראלי אמר שמפתיע שהילדה הטורקייה שרדה.
claims.quote: "It's surprising that she managed to survive," said one member of the Israeli team, a doctor.

claims.text: לפי JTA מ-1 בפברואר 2000, אליף גונדוז בת ה-11 ביליתה ארבעה ימים לכודה מתחת להריסות בצ'ינארג'יק לפני שצוות החילוץ הגיע אליה.
claims.quote: Alif Gondoz, 11, spent four days trapped beneath rubble in the city of Cinarcik before the rescue team reached her.

claims.text: לפי JTA, גונדוז איבדה את כל משפחתה הקרובה ברעידה והגיעה לישראל עם שתי דודות להמשך שיקום.
claims.quote: Gondoz, who lost all of her immediate family in the quake, arrived in Israel this week accompanied by two aunts to continue her rehabilitation.

claims.text: לפי JTA, גונדוז הובאה לישראל על ידי הג'וינט האמריקאי, שמעניק סיוע הומניטרי מתמשך לנפגעי הרעידה בטורקיה.
claims.quote: Gondoz was brought to Israel by the American Jewish Joint Distribution Committee, which has provided ongoing humanitarian aid to earthquake victims in Turkey.

claims.text: לפי JTA, פומרנץ מספר שהאוכלוסייה הטורקית המקומית הייתה מוצפת הכרת תודה על עבודת החיילים הישראלים.
claims.quote: Pomeranz recalls how the local Turkish population was overwhelmed with gratitude by the work done by the Israeli troops.

claims.text: לפי JTA, עשרות אזרחים טורקים מריעים מחאו כפיים לכל חילוץ מוצלח והריעו לחיילים כשיצאו הביתה.
claims.quote: Dozens of cheering Turkish citizens applauded each successful rescue and cheered gratefully as the soldiers headed for home.

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur, צוותי החילוץ ורופאי הצבא קיימו בצ'ינארג'יק טקס אזכרה ל-11 ישראלים ולעשרות אלפי טורקים שנהרגו.
claims.quote: In Cinarcik, the IDF rescue teams and army doctors held a memorial service for the 11 Israelis and tens of thousands of Turks who perished.

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur, ישראל הציעה לשקם חלק מהאזור שנפגע ברעידה.
claims.quote: Israel offered to rehabilitate part of the area damaged by the earthquake.

claims.text: לפי ה-Christian Science Monitor, מאמצי הסיוע של צה"ל משמשים סוג של דיפלומטיה שקטה עבור ישראל ברחבי העולם.
claims.quote: And such efforts are acting as a sort of quiet diplomacy for Israel around the globe.

claims.text: לפי ה-Christian Science Monitor, בפיגוע בשגרירות ארה"ב בנאירובי באוגוסט 1998 ישראל השתלטה על מבצע החיפוש וההצלה.
claims.quote: When terrorists blew up the US Embassy in Nairobi, Kenya, in August 1998, killing 257 people, it was Israel that took control of the search-and-rescue operation.

claims.text: לפי מעריב, חילוצה של שירן פרנקו נצרב בזיכרון הישראלי בזכות התמונות המרגשות.
claims.quote: ונצרבה גם בזיכרון הישראלי בזכות התמונות המרגשות של חילוצה של הילדה שירן פרנקו

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום, פרץ זכה לאות הוקרה על פועלו באירוע.
claims.quote: במשך כמה שנים שמרו הצדדים על קשר, אך זה לבסוף התנתק. על פועלו באירוע זכה דוד לאות הוקרה.

claims.text: לפי ynet מ-2019, מאז הרעידה חלפו 20 שנה ושירן בגרה, שיקמה את חייה, התגייסה לצבא, נישאה והביאה ילדים.
claims.quote: 20 שנה חלפו מאז. היא בגרה. שיקמה את חייה. התגייסה לצבא. נישאה והביאה ילדים.

claims.text: לפי ynet, אשכנזי סיפר שבגיל 50 השתחרר מהצבא וקיבל הצעה מאוניברסיטת הרווארד לנהל צוות אסונות וטרור בבית הספר לבריאות הציבור, ושראה בשירן טריגר משמעותי לכך.
claims.quote: בגיל 50 השתחררתי מהצבא וקיבלתי הצעה מאוניברסיטת הרווארד - לנהל צוות של אסונות וטרור במסגרת בית הספר לבריאות הציבור

claims.text: לפי ה-Christian Science Monitor, כתב הצבאי זאב שיף מהארץ אמר שליחידה טובה אבל היא עולה הון.
claims.quote: "They have a good unit, but it costs a fortune," says Zeev Schiff, one of Israel's foremost military-affairs reporters at the Haaretz newspaper.

claims.text: לפי ה-Christian Science Monitor, שיף אמר שעלות מאמץ החילוץ באוגוסט בטורקיה הייתה גבוהה מאוד.
claims.quote: The cost for the August rescue effort in Turkey, he says, was extremely high.

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום, פרץ סיפר שאחרי החזרה מטורקיה הוא וחלק מהחבורה סבלו מטראומה, והוא חזר לתלם רק אחרי חצי שנה.
claims.quote: היתה לי ולחלק מהחבר'ה טראומה. רק אחרי חצי שנה חזרתי לתלם

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur, הצוות הישראלי הציל ילדה ישראלית בת 9, שירן פרנקו, שהייתה לכודה ארבעה ימים מתחת להריסות; אחיה התאום, אביה וסביה נהרגו.
claims.quote: There was high drama as the Israeli rescue team saved a 9- year-old Israeli girl, Shiran Franco, who had been trapped for four days beneath rubble.

claims.text: לפי ynetnews, משלחת חיפוש והצלה ישראלית חילצה אותה אחרי 5 ימים, אך אביה, אחיה וסביה לא שרדו.
claims.quote: An Israeli search and rescue expedition was dispatched to Turkey and managed to retrieve her after 5 days but her Father, brother and grandparents did not survive.

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur מ-25 באוגוסט 1999, צוותי צה"ל חילצו 12 ניצולים וגילו 146 גופות בשלושה אתרים מאז הגיעו ביום רביעי הקודם.
claims.quote: The IDF teams rescued 12 survivors and uncovered 146 bodies at three sites since they arrived there last Wednesday.

claims.text: לפי Dei'ah veDibur, הרשויות הטורקיות העריכו אז שכ-40,000 בני אדם נהרגו, והמספר הסופי עלול להיות גבוה יותר.
claims.quote: Turkish authorities are now estimating that some 40,000 perished. However, this is not a final number and the final count may be even higher.

claims.text: לפי ynetnews, רעידת 1999 גבתה למעלה מ-18,000 חיים.
claims.quote: Shiran Franco, who miraculously survived of the 1999 Turkey earthquake which claimed over 18,000 lives
